items.name: Dicklesworthstone/frankensonos
items.title: Dicklesworthstone/frankensonos
items.description: Memory-safe Rust controller for your own Sonos speakers on your own LAN — reliable SSDP/UPnP-SOAP/GENA interoperability (S1 + S2), a Spotify-library classical DJ, and a CLI + HTTP API + MCP server so AI agents can run the house, including off-LAN over Tailscale.
